sections.description: One list each. Default: your open merge requests (scope created_by_me) and your assigned open issues.

params.description: Query parameters for GET /api/v4/merge_requests or /api/v4/issues, e.g. { scope: all, reviewer_username: dana, state: opened }.

token_command.description: A command that prints the token, e.g. [op, read, "op://dev/gitlab/token"]. Used instead of token_env.

token_env.description: Variable holding a personal access token (read_api scope). Default GITLAB_TOKEN.

entries.description: GitLab merge requests and issues, one list per section, each a query on the REST API with your own parameters (scope, state, labels, reviewer...). Merge conflicts show red, ready-to-merge green, overdue issues red. Click an item to open it. gitlab.com or self-managed. Untested live: built from the API docs and a sample response.
